summary: Include overlay build outputs in install identity unless their exclusion is proven safe.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only overlay identity excludes only installed node_modules and VCS .git directories. Other outputs remain included because no generation-inventory exclusion proof exists. Refreshed local installed bytes are covered by regression tests.

recovery.detail: Build-written overlay files can invalidate subsequent keys; no silent output exclusion can replay stale dependencies.
